# 👋 Welcome to FairCoin Discussions!

Welcome to the FairCoin community discussion forum! We're excited to have you here.

## 🌟 About FairCoin

FairCoin is a community-driven fair transaction system built on principles of **Light & Truth**, **Love & Mercy**, and **Just & Peace**. We're building a more equitable economic system through innovative fairness metrics (PFI★ and TFI★) and democratic governance.

## 💬 What are Discussions?

This is a space for our community to:

- 💡 **Share ideas** for new features and improvements
- 🙏 **Ask questions** and get help from the community
- 🏗️ **Discuss development** and technical topics
- 🎨 **Collaborate on design** and user experience
- 📊 **Talk about governance** and economic fairness
- 🎉 **Showcase** what you've built with FairCoin
- 💬 **Connect** with other community members

## 📋 Discussion Categories

### 📢 Announcements
Official project updates, releases, and important news from the FairCoin team.

### 💡 Ideas
Got a feature request or suggestion? Share it here! Community feedback helps us prioritize development.

### 🙏 Q&A
Ask questions about using FairCoin, understanding fairness metrics, or anything else. Community members and maintainers are here to help.

### 🏗️ Development
Technical discussions about code, architecture, pull requests, and development processes.

### 🎨 Design & UX
Share design mockups, discuss UI/UX improvements, and collaborate on making FairCoin more user-friendly.

### 📊 Governance & Economics
Discuss PFI★ and TFI★ metrics, governance models, voting systems, and economic fairness principles.

### 💬 General
Everything else! General discussions about FairCoin, the community, and related topics.

### 🎉 Show and Tell
Built something cool with FairCoin? Share it here! We love seeing what our community creates.

### 🔐 Security
Public discussions about security best practices and general security topics. 

> ⚠️ **Important**: Do NOT post security vulnerabilities here. Use [private security advisories](https://github.com/jonipwi/faircoin.app/security/advisories/new) instead.

## 🤝 Community Guidelines

We ask everyone to follow these principles:

### Light & Truth
- Be honest and transparent in your communications
- Provide accurate information and cite sources
- Correct mistakes when you make them

### Love & Mercy
- Treat everyone with kindness and respect
- Welcome newcomers warmly
- Be patient and understanding
- Assume good intentions

### Just & Peace
- Foster an inclusive, welcoming environment
- Give credit where credit is due
- Resolve conflicts constructively
- Focus on what's best for the community

### General Etiquette
- ✅ Search before asking - your question might already be answered
- ✅ Be specific and provide context
- ✅ Stay on topic and use appropriate categories
- ✅ Mark helpful answers in Q&A discussions
- ❌ No spam, self-promotion, or off-topic content
- ❌ No harassment, discrimination, or trolling
- ❌ No sharing of sensitive or private information

## 🚀 Getting Started

### New to FairCoin?
- Read the [README](https://github.com/jonipwi/faircoin.app/blob/main/README.md)
- Check out the [Quick Start Guide](https://github.com/jonipwi/faircoin.app#-quick-start)
- Review the [Contributing Guide](https://github.com/jonipwi/faircoin.app/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md)

### Want to Contribute?
- Browse [Good First Issues](https://github.com/jonipwi/faircoin.app/labels/good%20first%20issue)
- Join as a [Collaborator](https://github.com/jonipwi/faircoin.app/issues/new?template=collaboration.yml)
- Review the [Development Guide](https://github.com/jonipwi/faircoin.app/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#-getting-started)

### Have Questions?
- Post in the **Q&A** category
- Tag relevant topics for better visibility
- Provide as much context as possible
